independent_reference.formula: B_i[-theta_i + k/gamma*(Lp_i-Gp_i·Lx_i+rho_w DA_i)], B_i=Kw/[1-(1-n0)/J_i], gamma=rho_w*9.80665. Independent O(N²) host search over stored actual double positions, saved float p/Ace, actual frozen C matrices, and V_j=V0 J_j; no production nsearch/cell-table traversal is reused.
independent_reference.discrete_terms: w_ij=Vj*d·[(Ci+Cj)g]/(r²+Eta²); Lp=sum w*dp; Lx=sum w*d; Gp=-sum Vj*dp*Ci*g; DA=sum Vj*(Ace_j-Ace_i)·Ci*g. Host calls actual project Wendland float kernel factor at float(r²). No independently rewritten kernel formula is used.
independent_reference.budget: Before execution: error<=64*FLT_EPSILON*S +256*DBL_EPSILON*max(1,abs(B theta))+1e-6 Pa/s; S=B[abs(theta)+k/gamma*(sum abs(w dp)+sum_axis(sum abs(Vj dp gi_axis))*(sum abs(w d_axis))+rho_w*sum Vj*sum_axis abs(deltaAce_axis*gi_axis))]. The complete pre-cancellation raw discrete-term scale covers float kernel-factor propagation plus double accumulation/FMA and final float storage. It is not a physical 5Pa allowance.
independent_reference.reporting: Every rate row exports actual/reference/error/budget/error_over_budget and separate signed pressure and acceleration contributions. max_error_over_budget must stay<=1. k0 values must additionally equal the directly rounded complete float formula, constants/constant flux must be exactly zero. Affine_balance independently requires both absolute host-reference complete rate and absolute actual complete rate<=the same original propagated raw-term budget, not merely agreement of two possibly inconsistent operators. Quadratic pressure is compared to the actual discrete operator, never an exact continuum Laplacian.
independent_reference.nonempty: The nonlinear patch field must have both separate pressure and acceleration rate contributions greater than ten times its declared first-row budget. Periodic C owner norm must be finite/nonzero; all four requested ghost arrays are poisoned and then repaired.
